candidates.change_summary: Delete the balance update so deposits no longer credit the sender's balance.
Replace the additive balance update with an assignment so the balance is overwritten rather than incremented.
Credit MinDeposit instead of msg.value so the credited amount differs from the deposited amount.
Move the balance update out of the if block so any deposit (even below/at MinDeposit) changes balances.
Change the deposit threshold check from msg.value > MinDeposit to msg.value >= MinDeposit so deposits equal to MinDeposit are now accepted.
Delete the statement that adds msg.value to the sender's balance, so deposits no longer increase balances[msg.sender].
Delete the TransferLog.AddMessage call so deposits are no longer recorded in the Log contract's History.
Move the balance deduction after the external call, reintroducing the reentrancy window so the externally visible balance differs during and after reentrant CashOut calls.
Replace the strict inequality check `_am<=balances[msg.sender]` with `_am<balances[msg.sender]`, so withdrawing exactly the full balance now reverts and leaves the balance unchanged.
Delete the `revert()` in the else-branch so a failed external call no longer rolls back, leaving balances decremented and no log entry added.
Send the whole contract balance (`address(this).balance`) instead of `_am`, changing both the ETH transferred and (after revert on insufficient funds) the resulting balances state.
